senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sent, despatched.
m. (-तः)
1 A messenger or envoy, a news-carrier.
2 An ambassador.
f. (-तिः-ती)
A female messenger, a confidante, a procuress, a go-between, &c.
E.
दु to go, Uṇādi affix क्त, and the vowel made long; or दू to suffer, affix क्त, fem. affix क्तिन् or क्तिच्, and optionally ङीप्.

f. (-घ्नी)
A plant, resembling the Kadamba: see कदम्बपुष्पी.
E.
दूत a messenger, घ्नी what destroys.

f. (-का)
A female messenger, a confidante, &c. see दूत, &c.
E.
कन् added to दूति; also with the penultimate vowel made long, दूतीका.

n. (-त्यं)
1 An embassy, a message.
2 The abstract state or condition of a message or a messenger.
E.
दूत a messenger, and यत् aff.
